svg.text: Prototype wiring 1 of 2: the Pi 5 header, pin by pin
Seen from above, pin 1 (square pad) at the top, the end farthest from the USB ports. Wire colours are for the drawing only.
kept free: CAN stack B INT
Ground: any GND pin works; 6, 20 and 39 feed the rails. 3V3 / 5V pins are joined inside the Pi.
GPIO pins are 3.3 V only: nothing at 5 V or more ever goes to one.
